mapper.select: select fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as duebillseqno, fin.ISSUE_AMT as duebillamt, fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 as finprodType from FIN_PRODUCT fin left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin on fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID where fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{duebillseqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pafin.CASH_OUT_NO = #{putoutorderno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select sum(ptl.AMOUNT) from PTL_SEC_POSITION ptl where to_char(ptl.CDATE,'yyyyMMdd') = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ptl.FINPROD_ID = (select fin.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT fin , PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin where fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID and fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{duebillseqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pafin.CASH_OUT_NO = #{putoutorderno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select 100 - sum(nvl(p.PRIN_AMT,0)) from FIN_CASH_PLAN p left join FIN_CASH_INFO i on i.CASH_ID = p.CASH_ID and i.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{benjiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} left join FIN_PRODUCT t on t.FINPROD_ID = i.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pa on pa.FINPROD_ID = t.FINPROD_ID where pa.CASH_OUT_NO = #{putoutorderno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{duebillseqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.MDATE <= to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
